purpose: The content of DA_MelodiaDressingCatalog, derived from the props the artist already placed, keyed by the gameplay-tag family the artist already used. This is the catalogue the art pass (Dash role) reads: family tag -> hero prop set, so a dressing pass places existing library assets instead of inventing a new authority.

authority.source_of_truth: the map itself (/Game/Melodia/Levels/Opening/L_MelusinaHouse_P0). This file is its reproducible record, never a competing one.
authority.guardrail: read-only derivation: the generator never touches Content, never opens the editor and never moves an actor.

tag_vocabulary.family_tag: Room_<room> - the gameplay-tag family the catalogue is keyed by. One family per room: a dressing pass asks for a room, not a mesh.
tag_vocabulary.prop_tag: Prop_<mesh leaf name> - one hero prop inside a family.

layer.base: the Magician's Library architecture and furniture.
layer.enchanted_interiors: Kitbash3D Enchanted Interiors props, converted onto M_Master_Toon_Universal on 2026-10-21.
layer.functional: hand-placed interactables that carry the gameplay.

rules: a family is a room, not a mesh list - the art pass asks for a room and gets that room's hero props
a prop keeps its mesh and its material instance exactly as placed; the catalogue never re-points a prop at a different master
a placement is recorded so the catalogue can be reconciled against the map, not so the map can be overwritten from the catalogue
the catalogue is the fill layer's source of truth for WHICH props exist; the fill contract (specs/p0/melusina_house_p0_fill.v1.json) is the source of truth for WHERE and HOW MANY of them are placed
no gameplay tag is invented here: the families use the tags the artist already set on the actors
not_yet_true: the DataAsset itself does not exist - there is no UMelodiaDressingCatalog class, so this content cannot yet be loaded by the subsystem
UMelodiaDressingSubsystem::DressHeroClutter is a scaffold: it logs and returns true, it does not place anything
no family has been validated by an actual dressing pass - the catalogue records what exists, not what looks right
